§6Large Mining Drill§f

§aThe only machine that can pull bedrock ore out of the ground  -  your gateway to infinite resources!§f

The §bLarge Mining Drill§f is a 7x7x7 pseudo-multiblock that mines a 3x3 column straight down to bedrock. It cannot mine depth rock, but once it hits bedrock it starts extracting ore that never runs out.

§6Crafting§f (Assembly Factory):
§b•§f 8x Stone Bricks, 8x Steel Ingot, 8x Iron Ingot, 2x Motor, 1x Analog Circuit Board.

§6Operation§f:
§b•§f Base power draw: §e10 kHE/t§f.
§b•§f Speed with steel drillbit: ~§e300 seconds§f per raw ore.
§b•§f Needs a drillbit to operate. Steel to start, upgrade to Desh later.
§b•§f Output port near the miller connects to a Bedrock Ore Processor.

§6GUI toggles§f: Walling (sandbags), Silk Touch, Crushing, Vein Mining.

§ePS:§f Hook the output directly to a Bedrock Ore Processor for a fully automated infinite resource pipeline!
